environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with RLS policies enabled. The service container runs as non-root with read-only filesystem except /tmp. Network egress is allowed to RDS (port 5432) and to the internet via NAT gateway for vendor webhook callbacks. libxmljs2 v0.33.0 installed. No XML-specific request filtering configured on the ALB.

config.network: Internal ALB -> ECS tasks, NAT gateway for egress
config.alb_rules: path-based routing only, no content inspection
